title: Authorize headless machines with the OAuth device code flow (Beta)
body: You can now get a workspace-level OAuth token on a headless machine, such as a remote VM or container, by finishing sign-in in a browser on another device. Workspace admins can turn this on from the **Previews** page. See [Authorize headless access with the OAuth device code flow](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-device-code).
